title: Causal Discovery for Linear Models with Latent Confounding via Multi-domain Identifiable Representation Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.28134v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Causal discovery with latent confounding is particularly challenging, but a common setting in real-world data. In this work, we focus on linear causal models with latent confounding, represented by acyclic directed mixed graphs (ADMGs). Existing methods that fully identify ADMGs typically assume non-Gaussianity or graphical constraints, such as bow-freeness. In contrast, we propose Linear ADMG Learning (LinADMG), a framework for learning ADMGs for linear causal models through identifiable representation learning. Rather than relying on non-Gaussianity or bow-freeness, LinADMG leverages multi-domain settings to identify the noise variables. We show that the identifiability of the noise variables is sufficient for recovering all direct causal relations, and that, under an additional latent-confounding no-cancellation condition, LinADMG can identify the whole ADMG. translated_title: 基于多域可辨识表示学习的含潜在混杂线性模型因果发现
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.28134v1 公告类型：交叉发布。摘要：含潜在混杂的因果发现特别具有挑战性，但这是现实世界数据中的常见情形。在本工作中，我们关注用无环有向混合图（ADMG）表示的含潜在混杂线性因果模型。现有的能够完全辨识ADMG的方法通常假设非高斯性或图结构约束（如无弓性）。与之相反，我们提出了线性ADMG学习（LinADMG），一个通过可辨识表示学习来学习线性因果模型ADMG的框架。LinADMG不依赖非高斯性或无弓性假设，而是利用多域设置来辨识噪声变量。我们证明，噪声变量的可辨识性足以恢复所有直接因果关系；并且在附加的潜在混杂无抵消条件下，LinADMG能够辨识整个ADMG。我们采用四种可辨识表示学习方法实现了LinADMG（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出LinADMG框架，利用多域可辨识表示学习来辨识噪声变量，从而在不依赖非高斯性或无弓性假设的情况下，实现对含潜在混杂的线性因果模型ADMG的辨识与因果发现。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes LinADMG, a framework that leverages multi-domain identifiable representation learning to identify noise variables, enabling causal discovery of the full ADMG for linear models with latent confounding without relying on non-Gaussianity or bow-freeness assumptions.
